products.name: Flowise
products.note: Visual LLM workflow builder; low-code RAG; self-hosted; no-code agent building

profile_text.body:
Flowise is an open-source generative AI development platform designed to help developers and teams build AI agents and orchestrate large language model workflows. The company describes its product as providing modular building blocks that support everything from simple compositional workflows to autonomous agents, and it offers deployment options for both cloud and on-premises environments with what it characterizes as enterprise-grade infrastructure.

The core product, also called Flowise, is a visual, low-code tool for constructing LLM workflows, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, and no-code agent configurations. Customers quoted on the site include UneeQ, which describes using Flowise to orchestrate AI within its proprietary system called Synapse for digital human experiences, and other users who cite it for embedding AI features into analytics platforms and building internal AI assistant initiatives.

The held facts confirm Flowise maintains a tracked presence on theworldofai.org under the Coding and Developer Tools category, with no litigation, SEC filings, or patent records currently on file.
